property_summary: For any amount, a withdraw from a caller whose receive() consumes more than the 2300-gas transfer stipend must revert (transfer propagates the failure and c keeps its balance); the mutant's unchecked low-level call supplies full gas, so the same withdraw silently succeeds, violating the rule.
change_summary: Replaced transfer with call so a failing/reverting or gas-consuming recipient changes the observable result of the call.
